title: Speculating LLMs' Chinese Training Data Pollution from Their Tokens
abstract: arXiv:2508.17771v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tokens are basic elements in the datasets for LLM training. It is well-known that many tokens representing Chinese phrases in the vocabulary of GPT (4o/4o-mini/o1/o3/4.5/4.1/o4-mini) are indicating contents like pornography or online gambling. Based on this observation, our goal is to locate Polluted Chinese (PoC) tokens in LLMs and study the relationship between PoC tokens' existence and training data. (1) We give a formal definition and taxonomy of PoC tokens based on the GPT's vocabulary. (2) We build a PoC token detector via fine-tuning an LLM to label PoC tokens in vocabularies by considering each token's both semantics and related contents from the search engines. (3) We study the speculation on the training data pollution via PoC tokens' appearances (token ID). translated_title: 从词元推测大语言模型的中文训练数据污染
translated_abstract: 词元是大语言模型训练数据集中的基本元素。众所周知，在GPT（4o/4o-mini/o1/o3/4.5/4.1/o4-mini）的词表中，许多表示中文短语的词元都指向色情或网络赌博等内容。基于这一观察，我们的目标是在大语言模型中定位受污染中文词元，并研究这类词元的存在与训练数据之间的关系。（1）我们基于GPT的词表给出了受污染中文词元的形式化定义和分类体系。（2）我们通过微调一个大语言模型构建了受污染中文词元检测器，综合考虑每个词元的语义以及来自搜索引擎的相关内容，对词表中的受污染中文词元进行标注。（3）我们研究了如何通过受污染中文词元的出现情况（词元ID）来推测训练数据是否受到污染。在GPT及其他23个大语言模型上的实验表明，这类词元广泛存在，而GPT的词表表现最差：超过40%的较长中文词元（即包含……
tldr: 该论文首次对大语言模型词表中的受污染中文词元给出形式化定义与分类，通过微调LLM构建词元检测器，并利用受污染词元的出现情况推测模型中文训练数据的污染程度，实验发现GPT词表受污染最为严重。
en_tdlr: This paper formally defines and classifies Polluted Chinese (PoC) tokens in LLM vocabularies, builds an LLM-based token detector, and speculates training data pollution from PoC token appearances, revealing that GPT's vocabulary exhibits the worst pollution.
